boundary: This graph is synthetic, metadata-only architecture evidence. It grants no production, clinical, PHI, payer, EHR, device, commercial, partnership, or distribution authority. This registry describes SCRIMED's locally implemented, synthetic/no-PHI platform foundations and evidence paths. It does not authorize PHI, autonomous clinical care, diagnosis, treatment, prescribing, payer submission, EHR writeback, medical-device connectivity, production deployment, certification claims, customer activation, investor outreach, valuation claims, or revenue guarantees.

nodes.label: A clean exact candidate has attributable source and independent review.
A distinct named reviewer approves the exact candidate.
A current AAL2 operator credential is bound to the action and candidate.
Database owner approves the exact migration set after disposable dry run.
Clinical governance and counsel approve intended and prohibited use.
Qualified clinical safety leadership approves the exact evidence and boundaries.
Privacy owner approves data purpose, minimization, retention, and disclosures.
Qualified counsel approves claims, contracts, and regulatory posture.
Security owner approves identity, isolation, threat model, and incident controls.
Provider service scope, contract, subprocessors, residency, logs, and retention are approved.
Deployment authority approves exact candidate, target, window, monitoring, and rollback.
Authorized production deployment passes environment-bound smoke and rollback checks.
Customer-specific intended use, contracts, operators, support, acceptance, and rollback are approved.
